request: what does parse_dates in report.py do with a date that has no timezone?

text: {"answer": "In report.py, parse_dates (lines 4-11) parses each row's r['when'] with datetime.fromisoformat (line 7). If the result has no tzinfo (line 8), it treats the value as UTC by calling d.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc) (line 9). That attaches UTC without shifting the clock time. Every value, naive or aware, is then converted with astimezone(timezone.utc) (line 10) and appended to the returned list, so all outputs are UTC-aware datetimes."}

In report.py, parse_dates (lines 4-11) parses each row's r['when'] with datetime.fromisoformat (line 7). If the result has no tzinfo (line 8), it treats the value as UTC by calling d.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc) (line 9). That attaches UTC without shifting the clock time. Every value, naive or aware, is then converted with astimezone(timezone.utc) (line 10) and appended to the returned list, so all outputs are UTC-aware datetimes.
